candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether an evaluated facility is treated as a significant industrial user governed by this list affects which pretreatment-linked effluent limits, monitoring obligations, and missing-evidence cases are in scope.

The categorical-determination Y/N column signals whether categorical pretreatment standards apply; interpreting a user as categorically determined versus not can change which enforceable numeric limits and categorical monitoring requirements are treated as applicable.

The compliance-status column frames how reported pretreatment performance is documented; different readings of what status values mean could change whether a no-result period is classified as documented compliance, documented noncompliance, or unresolved missing evidence.

This report-type header denotes a 90-day compliance reporting obligation within the SIU reports block; whether and when that reporting was required can change monitoring-obligation applicability for the evaluated period.

The semi-annual/annual report column identifies periodic monitoring-reporting expectations for listed users; interpreting its scope or frequency differently could change which monitoring requirements are deemed applicable in FY2025.

These adjacent column headers tie self-monitoring obligations to effluent-limit tracking for industrial users; interpreting whether self-monitoring is required, report-only, or paired with enforceable limits could change both limit-applicability and monitoring-obligation results.
